params.name: tableName
params.description: Name of the table to remove

sentinelValues.meaning: vk table remove all: remove the table entirely, including style and data (default).
vk table remove style: remove the table's style but keep its data.
vk table remove data: remove the table's data but keep its style.

params.name: sheet
params.description: Sheet index (current sheet if omitted, indexing starts at 0)

overloads.semanticRole: The VP REMOVE TABLE command removes a table that you created with VP CREATE TABLE .

constraints: tableName must designate a table previously created with VP CREATE TABLE.
Table names are defined at sheet level.
